summary_en: Kurashicom authorized acquisition of up to 85,000 shares (1.15% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥141 million via ToSTNeT-3 between September 15, 2026 and July 31, 2027, as part of long-term capital efficiency improvement and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 14, 2026, Kurashicom's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 85,000 shares of its own common stock for a maximum aggregate of ¥141 million. The buyback will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading) between September 15, 2026 and July 31, 2027. This represents 1.2% of the 7,370,302 shares outstanding as of August 31, 2026, calculated from the disclosed share count.

The company stated that the buyback is not a short-term stock price support measure but part of a medium- to long-term capital policy. The primary objectives are to reduce the outstanding share count over time, thereby improving earnings per share and capital efficiency. The buyback aligns with Kurashicom's previously announced shareholder return rules and seeks to enhance corporate value through stronger capital allocation.

As of August 31, 2026, the company held 98 shares of treasury stock. The acquisition period extends over ten months, allowing flexible execution through off-auction trading during market conditions the company deems appropriate.
